rationale: The change adds a NEW render state (error) to AlertGroupChart and hardens buildCountChartQuery, and no existing Alerts spec touches the alert detail chart (grep for 'alerts-alertgroupchart' / 'alertgroupchart' / 'generate_sql' returns nothing in playwright-tests/). alerts-multialert-ui.spec.js covers the detail page but only the multi-alert layout (badge/stats/tabs), not the evaluation chart; alerts-scheduled-features.spec.js covers SQL preview on the create form, not the detail-page chart. The chart error state is its own feature area, so a dedicated Alerts/ spec (run-context spec_path) is the least-duplicative fit. It must be registered in ci_matrix.json (Alerts run_files).
